hero.titleLine2: Equip token compression, stop wasting tokens
hero.subtitle: Built-in 14-stage compression engine, relay proxy, and visual management center. Save 15-82% tokens, zero inference cost, runs locally — your data never leaves your machine.

relayProxy.title: Relay Proxy
relayProxy.description: Intercepts LLM calls at the request layer, enabling model hot-swapping at runtime without restarting. Supports dual-channel switching between the official LickClaw relay and custom Providers, all with a single click.
highlights: Dynamic model switching at runtime, no restart
Dual channel: official relay / custom Provider

compactor.title: Compactor
compactor.description: A 14-stage real-time message compression engine built on Fusion Pipeline. From code structure analysis to semantic deduplication, each stage is a specialized compressor chained in an immutable data flow. Zero LLM inference cost, 15-82% compression rate.
highlights: 14-stage Fusion Pipeline: Cortex → Photon → RLE → SemanticDedup → Ionizer → Neurosyntax → RepeatCrunch → TokenOptimizer
CJK text enhanced compression (12-stage pipeline + CJK tokenization)
Fully automatic, no manual operation needed

management.title: Visual Management
management.description: An integrated management panel unifying account management, channel switching, usage analytics, and Agent configuration. Plugin management supports drag-and-drop installation, enable/disable, and updates — all through a graphical interface.
highlights: Four tabs: Account / Channel / Usage / Agent

agents.title: Agent Enhancement
agents.description: Multi-tab Agent settings panel with basic info, tool management, and persona editing. Each Agent can independently configure enabled skills and tools for fine-grained Token control.
highlights: Multi-tab: Basic Info / Tool Management / Persona
Per-Agent skill configuration and tool toggles
New Agents default to all skills disabled, saving Tokens

gateway.title: Dual Version Parallel
gateway.description: Independent ports and config directories allow LickClaw and original ClawX to run simultaneously without conflicts. Fully isolated environments that don't interfere with each other.

features.pageSubtitle: Explore the core capabilities of LickClaw

openSource.description: Your data never leaves your machine. API Keys are stored using OS-native encryption for maximum security.
